name: Meter
description: How much of an allowance is used, such as a usage limit that resets. The bar fills as it is used: the info fill, like Progress, until `warnAt` of `max` is used (80% unless set), then the warning color, and a full warning bar when used up; never danger, and no success color.

props.name: max
props.description: The whole allowance, in the same units as `used`.

props.name: used
props.description: How much of the allowance is used, as the provider reports it, from 0 to `max`. The bar fills with it, and it is the meter's `aria-valuenow`.

props.name: valueText
props.description: What is used, in words, with the word: "62% used · resets in 3h". `MeterValue` shows it, and it is the meter's `aria-valuetext`, so the caller writes it once.

props.name: warnAt
props.description: The share of `max` used, from 0 to 1, at which the meter takes the warning color: at or above it. Clamped to 0 to 1.
